text:
Maya: Quick kickoff 94 launching a small suite: 3 how-to tutorials + 1 reference app + an OSS launch post. Need copy, a short benchmark narrative, webinar timing, and inbound routing. Who can own the benchmark writeup? :party:
Sam: I can own benchmarks. Need exact workloads, dataset prompts, and what metrics we want (p50/p95 latency, token cost, throughput). Planning a short reproducible script. Link to template: https://docs.redwood.com/benchmarks/template
Diego: I'll scaffold the refapp repo 94 starter repo with example prompts and a tiny CI demo. PR checklist idea: README, quickstart snippet, demo gif, minimal CI, LICENSE. Pushing starter branch in ~3 days.
Olivia: For the webinar: propose Wed 11am PT (good for NA+EU overlap). Recommend gated registration to collect company + use-case, then route leads to SDR with tags. Need a lightweight routing YAML for the marketing webhook. Example snippet we can reuse:
```yaml
route: 
  - match: { form: refapp-webinar }
    tags: ["refapp-oss","webinar-apr"]
    webhook: https://crm.example.com/webhooks/ingest
```
Sam: Nice. On routing, let's also add a quick mapping to product interest fields so SDRs can triage (eg: "inference-hosted", "dedicated", "private"). I'll add the webhook and tests.
announce-bot: Event created: "Tutorials + Refapp Launch" 94 2026-04-15 18:00 UTC. Registration form: https://go.redwood.com/refapp-launch (auto-created)
Maya: Copy direction 94 short benefit-led headline + simple steps. Draft headline: "Ship LLM features with fast, predictable inference on Redwood." Any objections?
Olivia: Slight tweak to avoid exact SLA claims: "Ship efficient LLM inference94fast, predictable, and cost-conscious." We should A/B test headline vs Maya's. Also recommend adding a single sentence about "runs on hosted, dedicated, or private" for enterprise teams.
Diego: Adding sample prompt sets and the bench script to the repo. Will include a tiny README command to reproduce: `python bench/run.py --model small --seq 512 --iters 100` and a sample results.json.
Sam: Benchmark narrative plan: 1) What we measured (latency/cost), 2) Why it matters (user impact), 3) How we measured (script + hardware), 4) TL;DR for marketing. I'll draft by Friday and attach the raw results for transparency.
Maya: Action items: Sam -> benchmark draft due Fri, Diego -> repo PR with demo + bench script by Mon, Olivia -> landing page copy + registration routing by Thu. I'll compile everything into a launch checklist and send a final prep thread next week. Ping here if any blockers. :thumbsup:
Olivia: One more 94 can we add a tiny follow-up email template for registrants that includes the refapp repo link and 1-click demo? I'll draft and share in #marketing-assets.
Maya: Love it. Thanks team 94 this is shaping up.
Sam: noted, will sync with @Diego on the bench data format.
Diego: cool, will add sample results.json and a short demo gif.
announce-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-04-08 94 prep review meeting (15m)
Maya: Perfect, see you all in the prep review.
